A small quest in the {wiki:Serpentine Tower|Serpentine Tower}, the sorcerers' guild of Ankrahmun. Put a pot on the fire to activate a magic field that takes you to a hidden room with a chest: inside is a {item:White Pearl}. The tower also holds an unsolved mystery involving caged creatures and levers.
Serpentine Tower, southeast of the Ankrahmun depot
to put on the open fire
Do not go below the ground floor of the tower: the lower part is dangerous.
Climb to the top of the tower

Go to the {wiki:Serpentine Tower|Serpentine Tower} in Ankrahmun, **southeast** of the {wiki:Depot|depot}, and climb to the top. If you are not in Ankrahmun, get there by boat (talk to the harbour captain in your city and say {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun} and {key:yes}). The tower is inside the city: the entrance is **1 floor above** the street, southeast of the depot.
Outside view of the Serpentine Tower
Go down to the ground floor
Inside the tower, go down to the ground floor.
Do not go below the ground floor: it is dangerous.
Put the pot on the fire
In the room to the **north**, put a {item:Pot} on the open fire. This activates the {item:Magic Forcefield|magic forcefield} on the **east** side of the room, which teleports you to the quest room.
Put the Pot on the open fire
Step into the teleport and take the {item:White Pearl} from the chest.

The small White Pearl room has stairs that lead down to the dangerous caged creatures area: **do not** use them to leave (only if you want to do the optional part below). Go back the way you came, climb inside the tower up to the entrance (1 floor above the street) and head out into the streets of Ankrahmun. The depot is right to the northwest.
Serpentine Tower (the entrance is 1 floor above)
Many players believe the tower hides more than the White Pearl. The mystery revolves around the caged creatures and the lever inside the {creature:Green Djinn}'s cage. There is no known reward.
In the small White Pearl room there is a {item:Wall Lamp|lamp} on the wall. Use it: it glows with red sparks on your body, but does not light up.
Go down to the caged creatures
Go down the {item:Stairs (White)|stairs} to the room with the caged creatures.
The {creature:Fire Elemental} is loose from now on!
Kill the {creature:Fire Elemental} and pull the lever inside its cage. This removes the {item:Magic Wall|Magic Walls} that trap the {creature:Green Djinn} on the floor below.
There is a lever in the {creature:Green Djinn}'s cage, but nobody knows what it does, or whether it does anything at all.
